## Description
Please include a summary of the change, motivation, and relevant issue numbers (e.g., `Fixes #12`).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] UI / Styling improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test addition / improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's coding style and vanilla JS guidelines.
- [ ] I have verified that this change makes **ZERO network calls** and requests no unnecessary permissions.
- [ ] I have run `npm test` and all automated tests pass.
- [ ] I have tested this in both Chrome and Firefox (unpacked).
- [ ] I have updated documentation (`README.md`, `CHROMEWEBSTORE.md`) where appropriate.
